🌀“Some traditions are carefully planned over time. Others become traditions before anyone realizes what happened.”

“Twenty-five years ago, nobody set out to create one of Paonia’s signature annual events. The idea was much simpler: make a CD featuring local musicians, throw a party to celebrate it, and give people a chance to hear the vast amount of music being created in the North Fork Valley at the time. A quarter-century later, the party is still on.”

-Stu Carlson, High Country Shopper and Spotlight

And we are honoring the origins of this beloved tradition in many ways on this 25th anniversary of the fest! 💿🌶️✨

➡️ Most notably, don’t miss the Mountain Harvest All Stars featuring original musicians from the very first installment. These legends were amazing then and are even more impressive now! Catch them in Paonia Town Park on Sunday at 3:30pm. 

➡️ Be sure to also join us for the Friday Night Street Party on Grand Ave, just like the very first fest. This special evening highlights all the quirky, fun, and artistic elements of the North Fork Valley. Explore art openings, grab some local grub, and be prepared for surprises. 

🗞️ Read Stu’s full write-up in the MHF Official Guide produced by High Country Spotlight & Shopper for the full heartwarming history of the festival.
